profile: Neogen develops, manufactures, and markets products and services for food and animal safety. Its food-safety offerings include diagnostic test kits, consumables, culture media, and software for detecting contaminants and assessing food quality, sold to producers, processors, laboratories, and regulatory agencies. Animal-safety products include veterinary instruments, medicines, vaccines, diagnostics, pest-control products, genomics testing, and drug-detection solutions distributed through industry channels.
